command:start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }'); base=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "cannot tell where this task branch started: no 'gnomish: task started' commit and no origin/main"; exit 1; }; oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$change/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $change/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$change"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$change/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $change/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: Task 6.2 (ticked) is not met: openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch has context lines, but the task says to make it 'without context, against the file as committed: `git diff -U0 -- docs/glossary/time-selection.md`'. Its hunk `@@ -5,4 +5,4 @@` keeps the old Time selection line ('...rounded to a track step and clamped to the reference day.') as context. The archived H1-glossary-track-end.patch, applied first, changes that line to '...clamped between the start of the reference day and the track end.', so with the required `git apply --unidiff-zero` the context no longer matches and task 6.2's scratch check (track-end patch, then `git apply --unidiff-zero` of this patch) fails. Regenerate the patch with zero context (only the -/+ lines for Day track and Handle).

handoff/README.md:9 (H1 **Apply** line) does not use the command task 6.2 requires 'exactly'; that command ends in `&& git apply --unidiff-zero openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch`. The README uses `git apply -C0 ...`, which works only because it ignores context. Restore the exact command once the patch has no context. The H1 'Automated part' should also name the scratch check of task 6.2 (both patches applied in order), not only `git apply --check` of the patch.

time_selection_drag_e2e.feature:9 and :27 set 'the screen is 375 by 340 px', but task 5.2 says the scenario runs 'at 375 × 300 px' and that if the start and end points do not fit, 'lower the offset here and in the spec scenario together'. The viewport was changed instead of the offset, and the spec was not changed with it. Use 300 px, or follow the task's rule for adjusting.

findings.message: NFR-A1 E2E scenario 'The slider reports the selected step after a drag' (time_selection_drag_e2e.feature:67-76) never sets `Given the pointer is "finger"`, so performDrag (time_selection_drag_e2e.steps.ts:98, `pointerKinds.get(world) ?? DragPointer.MOUSE`) drives a mouse drag. Task 5.2 requires 'after a finger drag to 75% of New York, the New York slider has aria-valuenow 1080 ...', and the spec scenario says 'WHEN the user drags a finger to three quarters of the New York track and lifts it'. Add the finger pointer step to this outline.

handoff/README.md:9: the H1 **Apply** line ends with `git apply -C0 openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch`. Task 6.2 requires the Apply line to be 'on that one line, exactly this command', which ends with `git apply --unidiff-zero openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch` (also used in task 6.2's verify step and in the README's own 'Automated part'). The patch is a zero-context (-U0) diff, so use --unidiff-zero as specified.

time_selection_drag_e2e.feature deviates from task 5.2 although the task is ticked: (a) the 'A drag continues when the pointer leaves the track' outline uses `the screen is 375 by 340 px` where the task specifies '375 × 300 px' and says 'if they do not fit, lower the offset here and in the spec scenario together'; (b) 'The dragged handle stays under the pointer' sets its width with `the screen is <width> px wide for the locations` instead of 'the existing step "the screen becomes {int} px wide" of steps/time_selection_labels_e2e.steps.ts' as the task requires. Follow the task, or revise tasks.md (and the spec offset) consistently.

findings.message: E2E/spec mismatch: time_selection_drag_e2e.feature:13 drags "90 px below it" while the spec delta (specs/time-selection/spec.md:130) still says "moves the pointer to three quarters of the track's width while 120 px below the track". Task 5.2 requires: "if they do not fit, lower the offset here and in the spec scenario together". Restore 120 px in the E2E feature, or lower it in the spec delta too and keep the unit feature (time_selection_drag_unit.feature:11, dragSteps.ts OFFSET_BELOW_PX) consistent.

Task 5.3 / M3 violated: the @fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness @FR5 tags were appended to the existing tag lines (time_selection_touch_e2e.feature:5 and :17, time_selection_legacy_tap.feature:5 and :16, time_selection_e2e.feature:6) instead of added as new lines. Task 5.3: "add the tags ... above these existing scenarios, with no other edit" and the check `git diff -U0 ... | grep -E '^[-+][^-+]' | grep -v '^+ *@'` must print nothing; M3: "git diff on the existing .feature files of time_selection/ shows only added tag lines". The changed lines appear as removed '-  @add-time-sliders-...' lines, so the check prints output. Put the new tags on a separate line above each scenario.

Handoff H1 departs from task 6.2: tasks.md says "make this patch without context" and gives the Apply line "exactly" as `... && git apply --unidiff-zero openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch`. H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch carries context lines (the Reference day and Time selection lines), and handoff/README.md:9 uses `git apply -C0` instead. tasks.md 'Human follow-up' H1 still tells the operator to apply it "with git apply --unidiff-zero", which fails with this patch once the track-end patch has rewritten the Time selection context line. Either regenerate the patch with zero context and use the prescribed --unidiff-zero Apply line, or bring tasks.md 6.2 and the H1 follow-up in line with the -C0 approach.
